TC-21/S28.title: NH Save & Extract and Generate: the 'generating' state while the physician moves on
TC-21/S28.detail: Local 25acd727, 10 cycles, Nursing Home only, fresh residents per cycle. Save & Extract answered at the socket at once; Generate answered with an injected failure after 8 s (on this build a stored note queues the server billing job, so a successful local Generate is not allowed); the note save is refused at the socket too. Each cycle: Save & Extract, Generate Note & Finish, open the second resident at once, come back to the first ~2.4 s after Generate (model still 'working'), then wait past the failure. Save & Extract worked 10/10 (U9). 'Generating Note…' shows before leaving (10/10, recorded), but on return it is gone 0/10 (Encounter idle, Post-Round 'No note generated yet.'), and after the failure no error is shown 0/10: the generating state and the failure live in the unmounted tab. Known: candidate N17 (generation is not on the server; TFA-92592 AC 'generation runs on the server … on return the note is there, or an explicit failure shows'). The generation code is unchanged from 43c38a4f (no diff in useNoteGeneration.ts / snf EncounterTab.tsx).
TC-21/S28.productIssue: A physician who taps Generate on a resident and moves to the next one finds no 'generating' state when coming back, and if the note failed no error is shown: the visit just looks like it was never generated (N17).
